newsitem.title: USA: STAT Healthcare to redeem Class A warrants.
newsitem.headline: STAT Healthcare to redeem Class A warrants.

text.p: STAT Healthcare Inc said Monday it will redeem its Class A redeemable common stock purchase warrants on December 9 at $0.05 per warrant.
Each Class A warrant entitles the holder to purchase one share of STAT common stock at an exercise price of $4.50 per share.
The Class A warrants will remain exercisable until 1700 EST on December 6, the business day preceeding the redemption date.
On and after December 9, holders of the Class A warrants will have no further rights except to receive, upon suspension of the warrant, the redemption price, the company said.
STAT Healthcare provides a continuing of disease management services, primarily to patients with end-stage renal disease, and also provides physician practice management services.
